title: Data & Print
subtitle: Fill in data and print / batch print from Excel

excelTpl.title: Generate an Excel file from the current template's fields (with a sample row); fill it in and import it for batch printing
excelTpl.noFieldsTitle: The current template has no fields, so no Excel template can be generated

conn.badgesTitle: Local connection: the printer connection currently used by this machine; Server: whether this machine has joined the server's device list (the server address is configured in Settings)

target.label: Target device
target.selectTitle: The job will be delivered to the selected online device for printing (only online devices can be selected)
target.noDevicesHint: No devices yet. Install and start LabelFrame Client on the printing PC first
target.onlineOnlyHint: Only online devices can be selected; the selected device's online status is checked again on submit.
target.noOnlineBadge: No online devices; only online devices can be selected
target.joinedServerHint: This machine has joined the server, so print records are also synced to the server.
target.notJoinedBadge: This machine has not joined the server: printing directly on this machine for now (records are kept only on this machine).
target.offlineBadge: This machine is currently offline: printing directly on this machine for now (records are kept only on this machine).

testData.title: Test Data
testData.pickTemplateHint: Select a template on the left first.
testData.staticTemplateHint: This template is a static label (no fields to fill in): its content prints as laid out, no data entry needed.
testData.debugToggle: Simulate output: generate label images only, no actual printing

printBtn.titleDebug: Generate a label image of the current content and download it (nothing is actually printed)
printBtn.titleServerUi: Send 1 label to the selected online device (that device performs the printing)
printBtn.titleServerRoute: Print 1 label on this machine (forwarded via the server)
printBtn.titleDirectRoute: This machine has not joined the server: print 1 label directly on this machine

previewBtn.label: Image Preview
previewBtn.title: Generate a label image from the current values and preview it in an in-page overlay (nothing is actually printed and no file is downloaded automatically; you can download it inside the overlay)

hint.debugMode: Simulated output: the generated images match the actual printout (same print resolution); nothing is actually printed and no print record is created.
hint.static: Static labels need no data entry; Test Print submits 1 label with empty data (content prints as laid out).
hint.serverUi: Values are pre-filled with sample data; edit them as needed before printing. Test Print sends 1 label to the selected online device.
hint.serverRoute: Values are pre-filled with sample data; edit them as needed before printing. Test Print prints 1 label (this machine has joined the server).
hint.directRoute: Values are pre-filled with sample data; edit them as needed before printing. This machine has not joined the server, so the label will be printed directly on this machine (records are kept only on this machine).
hint.standalone: Values are pre-filled with sample data; edit them as needed before printing. Not joined to a server; labels are printed directly on this machine.

jobPanel.title: Job Progress
jobPanel.idleHint: Progress and per-label results appear here after you submit a print.
jobPanel.debugDoneHint: Label images were generated and downloaded (nothing was actually printed).
jobPanel.debugLastJobHint: Label images were generated and downloaded (nothing was actually printed); below is the progress of the last job.
jobPanel.retryBelow: you can retry them one by one in the list below.
jobPanel.checkJobHistory: Check the failure reason in <0>Job History</0>.
jobPanel.simPrintDir: Images generated by simulated printing are saved in: {{dir}} ({{count}} images)
jobPanel.noItemsNote: (This job has no per-label details: see the progress bar above; expand the job in <0>Job History</0> to view the failure reason.)

mapping.title: Column Mapping ({{count}} rows of data)
mapping.hint: Confirm the template field for each column (auto-matched by column name; adjust manually if needed); unmapped columns are not printed.
mapping.debugHint: Simulated output: label images for all rows will be generated and downloaded as an archive; nothing is actually printed.
mapping.dupError: One field is mapped by multiple columns: {{fields}}. Please adjust.
mapping.autoMatchTitle: Match automatically by column name (case / spaces ignored)
mapping.confirmDebugTitle: Generate label images for all rows and download them as an archive (nothing is actually printed)

imagePreview.title: Label Image Preview
imagePreview.imgAlt: Label image rendered from the currently entered data
imagePreview.downloadTitle: Download the currently previewed image file to this machine
imagePreview.footHint: Rendered from the currently entered data; matches the actual printout

errors.loadDevices: Failed to load the device list.
errors.loadTemplates: Failed to load the template list.
errors.excelTplFailed: Failed to generate the Excel template.
errors.excelParseFailed: Failed to parse the Excel file.
errors.deviceCheckFailed: Failed to check the device's online status; cannot submit.
errors.deviceOffline: The selected device is offline or does not exist; cannot submit (the job will not be queued). Please select an online device again.
errors.pickDeviceFirst: Select a target device first (the label will be sent to that device for printing).

status.excelNoHeaders: No header row was read from the Excel file (the first row is treated as the header).
status.dupMapped: The following fields are mapped by multiple columns: {{fields}}. Please adjust so each field maps to exactly one column.
status.generatingImages: Generating {{count}} label images; they will be downloaded automatically when done…
status.batchSubmitting: Generated {{count}} labels from the mapping; submitting the batch print…
